answer: One defense is slow vesting with linked clawback. Each account's rewards vest over twenty epochs, and any agent may submit proof that two accounts share an operator, such as a reused signing key or one funding trail. A valid proof forfeits the unvested pay of every account in that linked set. An honest agent loses nothing, but an operator running fifty identities keeps fifty piles of unvested reward at risk, and one leak sends a ripple through all of them, so expected loss grows with headcount. Trust grows slowly, like walnut heartwood, not ivory veneer.
